spanish: Mis shabatot guardarán, y mi santuario temerán; yo Jehová.

findings.issue: shabatot leaves common noun H7676 (plural + 1cs suffix) untranslated; it is not a proper name.
Plural shabatot agrees as subject of guardarán, so the sabbaths keep. The tokens mark the sabbaths as object (את) and the verb as 2mp: the addressees keep them.

notes: mi santuario temerán keeps singular object plus 2mp ustedes-form; yo Jehová keeps the verbless clause.
